marketing.title: Revive manuscripts once considered dead
marketing.missionBody: At manuscritos.live we turn old manuscript images into useful, readable, reusable text for research, family archives, and historical memory.
marketing.revivalTitle: From dead document to living voice
marketing.revivalBody: Many manuscripts remain forgotten in boxes and archives. Our product brings them back to digital life so they can be studied, shared, and circulated again.
marketing.workflowBody: Upload an image, get a free incomplete summary, and unlock the full version when needed. Built to validate value quickly.
marketing.accessBody: Designed to work across multiple languages so different communities can rescue documentary heritage without technical barriers.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: It converts manuscript images into useful digital text for research, family archives, and historical memory.
faq.q2: What do I get for free?
faq.a2: An incomplete summary of the document so you can quickly assess value before unlocking the full version.
faq.a3: In this mockup, PayPal and MetaMask payments are simulated to validate the product experience.
faq.a4: Scans or focused photos, good lighting, low shadow, and enough resolution for readable text.
